name: devops-lsp
description: A DevOps marketplace of Claude Code language-server plugins. Add it once and use the same TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Python, shell, PHP, JSON, and YAML support in every project.

plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript code intelligence, plus a notify-only layer: an eslint check after edits and a tsc --noEmit check script. No automatic fixes.

plugins.name: rust-lsp
plugins.description: Rust code intelligence, plus a notify-only layer: a rustfmt parse check after edits and a cargo clippy check script. No automatic fixes.

plugins.name: python-lsp
plugins.description: Python code intelligence, plus a notify-only layer: a ruff check after edits and a basedpyright check script. No automatic fixes.

plugins.name: shell-lsp
plugins.description: Shell script code intelligence, plus a notify-only layer: a shellcheck check after edits and a shellcheck check script. No automatic fixes.

plugins.name: php-lsp
plugins.description: PHP code intelligence, plus a notify-only layer: a php -l parse check after edits and a PHPStan check script. No automatic fixes.

plugins.name: json-lsp
plugins.description: JSON and JSONC code intelligence, plus a notify-only layer: a prettier --check after edits and over the changed files. No automatic fixes.

plugins.name: yaml-lsp
plugins.description: YAML code intelligence, plus a notify-only layer: a prettier --check after edits and a yamllint check script. No automatic fixes.
